objects.textPreview: Your personal guide to government benefits
A resident-first path from one plain-language story to trusted programs and guided applications.
The benefit access gap is measurable
NCOA estimates for older adults use 2023 participation data and published average benefit values.
Estimated annual gap across SNAP, SSI, and Medicare Savings Programs
Estimated annual gap across the same three programs
NCOA's estimated 2023 annual gap for older adults
County and state values are derived estimates using NCOA nonparticipant counts and benefit assumptions.
Residents should not need to know the system
The burden today is on the person asking for help.
Programs are scattered across city, county, state, federal, utility, and community websites.
Eligibility language is hard to compare, and missing information can feel like a rejection.
The guidance often ends exactly when a resident reaches the official form.
The goal is not more information. It is a clear next action.
One conversation creates a guided path
Questions are optional. The resident stays in control of what they share.
Use natural language or choose a sample prompt.
Answer or skip focused follow-up questions.
See relevant programs with published rules and sources.
Ask questions, then continue on the official site with the side-panel guide.
Every result is built to be checked
AI explains the match. Published rules and program administrators decide.
Lower-income Sunnyvale homeowners who are seniors or have a disability
A short explanation based only on the facts the resident chose to share.
Ask about documents, next steps, deadlines, or published eligibility.
The guide stays beside the official application
The resident does not lose context when they leave the discovery page.
Find a relevant program and understand why it may apply.
Ask source-grounded questions about eligibility and documents.
Explain visible fields and offer resident-approved safe fills.
No form submission, signature, sensitive identifier, consent, or verification bypass.
A practical architecture built for reliability
Live demo: from a need to an application
